%% @spec walkthrough/2
%% @title Payment idempotency
%% @trigger The user taps Pay on the checkout page. A double tap, a reload or a retry after a lost response re-enters the same flow with the same key.
%% @term idempotency key: a unique id the client sends with a request so the server can recognise a repeat of that exact request and give the same answer without doing the work twice.
%% @term idempotent: safe to repeat; doing it twice has the same result as doing it once.
%% @term unique index: a database rule that lets a value appear in a column only once; a second insert of the same value fails or inserts nothing.
%% @term body hash: a short fingerprint (SHA-256) of the request body, used to notice when the same key is reused with different data.
%% @term replay: sending the saved answer of an earlier request again instead of running the request a second time.
%% @layer U kind=person The person paying. Taps Pay, and sometimes taps it twice.
%% @layer FE kind=client Checkout page in the browser. Creates the Idempotency-Key and keeps it until the payment settles.
%% @layer MW kind=middleware Express middleware in front of the payment routes. Makes sure one key means one charge.
%% @layer DB kind=db Postgres. The unique index on idempotency_keys.key is the lock that decides who goes first.
%% @layer PS kind=service Payment Service. Creates the payment and talks to the provider.
%% @layer PSP kind=external External payment provider. Also deduplicates on the key we forward.
autonumber
actor U as User
participant FE as Checkout UI
participant MW as Idempotency Middleware
participant DB as Database
participant PS as Payment Service
participant PSP as Payment Provider
%% @step The user presses Pay. Nothing has been sent yet, so this is the moment to decide which key this attempt uses.
U->>FE: Click "Pay ₹1,499"
%% @step The page looks for a key saved for this cart. Reusing it means a reload or double tap is treated as the same attempt, not a new charge.
%% @payload.input sessionStorage["pay:cart_77"] = "4f9c2e1a-7b7d-4c55-9a51-3e0d6b2f8c10"
%% @uses hook useIdempotencyKey src/checkout/useIdempotencyKey.ts:8 Reads the key for this cart from sessionStorage, or creates a new UUID and saves it.
%% @ref src/checkout/pay.ts:31

FE->>FE: Reuse key from sessionStorage
or create a new UUID
%% @step The key travels in a header so the server can recognise repeats of this exact request.
%% @payload.headers Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOi…
%% @payload.headers Idempotency-Key: 4f9c2e1a-7b7d-4c55-9a51-3e0d6b2f8c10
%% @payload.body { "cartId": "cart_77", "amount": 149900, "currency": "INR" }
%% @schema cartId string, required → 422 "cartId is required"
%% @schema amount integer in minor units, greater than 0 → 422 "amount must be positive"
%% @schema currency 3-letter ISO code → 422 "currency must be INR, USD or EUR"
%% @idempotent Repeats with the same key get the first answer back.
%% @timeout 10 s on the browser side, then the user may tap again with the same key.
%% @ref src/checkout/pay.ts:42

FE->>MW: POST /api/v1/payments
Idempotency-Key: 4f9c…
%% @section Claim the key
%% @summary The database, not the server, decides which request owns the key.
%% @step After hashing the body, the middleware tries to claim the key. The unique index lets exactly one request insert it; every other request gets 0 rows.
%% @payload.sql INSERT INTO idempotency_keys (key, user_id, body_hash, status) VALUES ('4f9c…', 'u_9', 'sha256:5f…', 'running') ON CONFLICT (key) DO NOTHING
%% @state before idempotency_keys has no row for key 4f9c…, or a row from an earlier attempt
%% @state after one row with status 'running' owned by this request, or nothing changed
%% @uses util hashBody src/middleware/hash.ts:5 SHA-256 of the raw request body, so a reused key with a different body can be noticed later.
%% @uses env IDEMPOTENCY_TTL_HOURS src/config.ts:14 How long a key row is kept (24 by default) before the cleanup job removes it.
%% @ref src/middleware/idempotency.ts:58

MW->>DB: INSERT idempotency_keys
ON CONFLICT (key) DO NOTHING
%% @step One row inserted means this request owns the key. Zero rows means the key was used before.
DB-->>MW: 1 row inserted (0 on conflict)
Note over MW,DB: The unique index is the lock
%% @section Charge once
%% @summary The owner of the key charges the card exactly once and saves the answer for everyone else.
alt Key claimed (1 row inserted)
%% @step This request owns the key, so it is passed on to the real payment handler.
%% @payload.body { "userId": "u_9", "cartId": "cart_77", "amount": 149900, "currency": "INR" }
%% @ref src/middleware/idempotency.ts:66
MW->>PS: next() → createPayment()
%% @step The key is forwarded to the provider too, so even a retry between us and the provider cannot charge twice.
%% @payload.headers Idempotency-Key: 4f9c2e1a-7b7d-4c55-9a51-3e0d6b2f8c10
%% @payload.body { "amount": 149900, "currency": "inr", "source": "tok_visa", "metadata": { "payment_id": "pay_456" } }
%% @retry 2 retries on a network error, same key each time, so a retry can never double charge.
%% @uses lib psp-sdk src/payments/provider.ts:4 The provider's client library; it adds the auth header and retries on network errors.
%% @ref src/payments/provider.ts:22

PS->>PSP: POST https://api.psp.example/v1/charges
Idempotency-Key: 4f9c…
%% @step The provider confirms the charge and returns its id.
%% @payload.body { "id": "ch_789", "status": "succeeded", "amount": 149900 }

PSP-->>PS: 200 OK
ch_789, status: succeeded
%% @step The handler answers with the new payment, now marked as paid.
%% @payload.body { "id": "pay_456", "status": "paid", "amount": 149900, "currency": "INR" }
%% @field id pay_456, created by the INSERT INTO payments just before this reply
%% @effect PaymentPaid event published for the receipt email worker
%% @ref src/payments/routes.ts:37

PS-->>MW: 201 Created
pay_456, status: paid
%% @step The response is saved against the key, so any later repeat gets the same answer without charging again.
%% @payload.sql UPDATE idempotency_keys SET status = 'done', response_code = 201, response_body = '{"id":"pay_456",…}' WHERE key = '4f9c…'
%% @ref src/middleware/idempotency.ts:91

MW->>DB: UPDATE idempotency_keys
SET status = done, response = 201
%% @step The browser gets the result of the one and only charge.
%% @payload.body { "id": "pay_456", "status": "paid", "amount": 149900, "currency": "INR" }
%% @effect Log line "payment created" with payment_id and key, for support searches
%% @ref src/middleware/idempotency.ts:97

MW-->>FE: 201 Created
pay_456, status: paid
%% @section Repeats
%% @summary A repeat never reaches the handler: it gets the saved answer, a wait, or a refusal.
else Key already used (0 rows)
%% @step The key exists, so the middleware reads what happened to the first request with it.
%% @payload.sql SELECT status, body_hash, response_code, response_body FROM idempotency_keys WHERE key = '4f9c…'
%% @ref src/middleware/idempotency.ts:70

MW->>DB: SELECT status, body_hash, response
WHERE key = '4f9c…'
%% @step The saved row for this key comes back.
DB-->>MW: 1 row: status, body_hash, response
alt Done, same body (the response was lost)
%% @step The browser receives the original answer again, marked as a replay. No second charge happened.
%% @payload.headers Idempotent-Replayed: true
%% @payload.body { "id": "pay_456", "status": "paid", "amount": 149900, "currency": "INR" }
%% @ref src/middleware/idempotency.ts:78

MW-->>FE: 201 Created
Idempotent-Replayed: true
else Still running
%% @step The first request is still being processed, so this one is told to wait instead of charging again.
%% @payload.headers Retry-After: 1
%% @payload.body { "error": "request_in_progress", "message": "A payment with this key is already being processed." }
%% @ref src/middleware/idempotency.ts:82

MW-->>FE: 409 Conflict
Retry-After: 1
else Different body
%% @step The key was reused for a different amount or cart. That is a client bug, so the request is refused with a 422 rather than guessed at.
%% @payload.body { "error": "idempotency_key_mismatch", "message": "This key was used with a different request body." }
%% @ref src/middleware/idempotency.ts:86

MW-->>FE: 422 Unprocessable Entity
"This key was used with a different request body."
end
end
%% @section Finish
%% @summary The key is thrown away once the money has moved, so the next purchase starts fresh.
%% @step The payment is settled, so the key is removed. The next checkout starts with a fresh key.
%% @uses hook useIdempotencyKey src/checkout/useIdempotencyKey.ts:21 Its clear() removes the key for this cart from sessionStorage.
%% @ref src/checkout/pay.ts:57
FE->>FE: Clear key from sessionStorage
%% @step The user sees one receipt for one charge, however many times they tapped.
%% @ref src/checkout/pay.ts:59
FE-->>U: Receipt for ₹1,499
